prompt: Draw our order process as a flowchart: it starts when an order arrives, we validate it, then check whether it's paid. If it is, we ship it and the process ends; if not, we send a reminder and check payment again.

checks.why: the payment check is a decision (diamond)
the decision's two exits are labelled

expect.$expr: (() => { const d = v.nodes.find((n) => n.shape === 'diam'); const out = v.edges.filter((e) => e.source === d.id); return out.length === 2 && out.every((e) => e.label); })()

checks.why: the reminder loops back to the decision

expect.$expr: (() => { const d = v.nodes.find((n) => n.shape === 'diam'); const r = v.nodes.find((n) => /remind/i.test(n.label)); return !!r && v.edges.some((e) => e.source === r.id && e.target === d.id); })()

checks.why: start and end are terminals (stadium or rounded)

args.source:
flowchart LR
  start([Start]) --> validate[Validate order]
  validate --> paid{Paid?}
  paid -->|yes| ship[Ship order]
  paid -->|no| remind[Send reminder]
  remind --> paid
  ship --> done([End])
